attributes.name: list item markup
attributes.definition: Whether list entries are rendered with leading icons or as plain text rows.

values.definition: List items are text only with no icons or bullet graphics.
List items have leading icons.
Another list treatment, or no lists.

attributes.name: list row separation
attributes.definition: How consecutive list rows are visually separated.

values.definition: Rows separated by thin horizontal lines.
Rows separated by whitespace without rules.
Each row is a boxed or carded item.
No list rows.

attributes.name: logo treatment
attributes.definition: How the brand mark in the header is presented.

values.definition: Logo is text only without a graphic symbol.
Logo combines a graphic symbol with text.
Logo is an image or SVG graphic.
Other or not present.

attributes.name: logo tagline
attributes.definition: Presence and styling of a tagline accompanying the logo.

values.definition: Small tagline with wide letter-spacing next to the logo.
Tagline without special letter-spacing.
No tagline with logo.

attributes.name: header layout and nav style
attributes.definition: How the logo and primary navigation are arranged and styled in the header.

values.value: logo and nav in one row, no dropdown carets
values.definition: Logo and navigation share a single row; nav items have no caret indicators.

values.value: logo and nav in one row with dropdown carets
values.definition: Single row with carets on nav items.

values.value: stacked or centered logo above nav
values.definition: Logo and nav on separate rows.
Other arrangement.
Each word capitalized.
All caps.
Lowercase or sentence case.
Other or not present.

codes.value: logo and nav in one row, no dropdown carets
